translation.deep: When you offer this supreme knowledge to fellow seekers, you are expressing the highest form of love for the Divine. By lighting the path for others, your own heart becomes a vessel of grace, ensuring your eventual union with the Supreme Truth.
translation.essence: Spreading the light of divine wisdom is a sacred service that leads the soul directly back to its eternal home.

18-69.sanskrit: न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्िचन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः।भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि।।18.69।।
18-69.transliteration:
na cha tasmān manuṣhyeṣhu kaśhchin me priya-kṛittamaḥ
bhavitā na cha me tasmād anyaḥ priyataro bhuvi

translation.simple: Among all people on this earth, there is no one who performs a service more pleasing to Me, nor will there ever be anyone more beloved to Me than the one who shares this wisdom.
translation.deep: The Divine looks with immense grace upon those who help others find their way back to the truth. By sharing these sacred teachings, you become a bridge for others to reach the Divine. In this selfless act of guiding souls, you earn a place of unique affection in the heart of the Lord, a bond that remains unsurpassed.
translation.essence: The highest form of love is to lead others toward the light of wisdom, making the seeker the most cherished of all in the eyes of the Divine.

18-70.sanskrit: अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः।ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः।।18.70।।
18-70.transliteration:
adhyeṣhyate cha ya imaṁ dharmyaṁ saṁvādam āvayoḥ
jñāna-yajñena tenāham iṣhṭaḥ syām iti me matiḥ

translation.simple: And I declare that whoever studies this sacred conversation of ours is worshipping Me through the sacrifice of knowledge. This is My firm belief.
translation.deep: In this verse, Shri Krishna elevates the act of spiritual study to a form of worship. By contemplating the eternal wisdom shared on the battlefield, the seeker offers their intellect to the Divine. This 'Jnana Yajna,' or sacrifice of knowledge, is considered by the Lord as a profound way to connect with Him, as it aligns the human mind with the Divine will.
translation.essence: Deepening our understanding of the Gita is a sacred ritual of the heart, where learning itself becomes a beautiful offering to God.

18-71.transliteration:
śhraddhāvān anasūyaśh cha śhṛiṇuyād api yo naraḥ
so ‘pi muktaḥ śhubhāl lokān prāpnuyāt puṇya-karmaṇām

translation.simple: Even someone who simply listens to these sacred words with faith and a heart free from ill-will becomes free. They reach the pure and happy realms reserved for those who have lived righteously.
translation.deep: Transformation begins with the humble act of listening. When we hear these divine truths with sincere trust and without a critical mind, our consciousness is purified. This simple devotion allows a person to transcend their limitations and attain the peaceful, auspicious worlds earned by those who perform virtuous deeds.
translation.essence: A heart filled with faith and a mind free from judgment are the keys to liberation and spiritual peace.

18-72.sanskrit: कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा।कच्चिदज्ञानसंमोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनञ्जय।।18.72।।
18-72.transliteration:
kachchid etach chhrutaṁ pārtha tvayaikāgreṇa chetasā
kachchid ajñāna-sammohaḥ pranaṣhṭas te dhanañjaya

translation.simple: O Arjuna, have you listened to all this with a focused and steady mind? Has the confusion caused by your ignorance now been completely dispelled?
translation.deep: In this gentle inquiry, the Lord emphasizes that spiritual wisdom can only take root when we listen with full presence. He seeks to know if the darkness of delusion has vanished, for only when the mind is clear can the soul find its true direction and purpose.
translation.essence: True clarity comes from listening with a quiet heart. When we focus on the divine truth, the fog of ignorance naturally fades away.

18-73.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाचनष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत।स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव।।18.73।।
18-73.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
naṣhṭo mohaḥ smṛitir labdhā tvat-prasādān mayāchyuta
sthito ‘smi gata-sandehaḥ kariṣhye vachanaṁ tava

translation.simple: Arjuna said: My confusion has vanished, and I have regained my wisdom through Your grace, O Krishna. I stand firm, free from all doubt, and I am ready to act according to Your will.
translation.deep: By Your divine blessing, the darkness of my delusion has been dispelled, and my true inner awareness has been restored. Every hesitation has melted away, leaving me steady and resolute. I now place my life in Your hands, prepared to fulfill the path You have shown me.
translation.essence: True clarity is found when we let go of our doubts and align our actions with the Divine will.

18-74.sanskrit: सञ्जय उवाचइत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः।संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम्।।18.74।।
18-74.transliteration:
sañjaya uvācha
ity ahaṁ vāsudevasya pārthasya cha mahātmanaḥ
saṁvādam imam aśhrauṣham adbhutaṁ roma-harṣhaṇam

translation.simple: Sanjaya said: I have now heard this wonderful and miraculous conversation between Lord Krishna and the great-souled Arjuna. It is so powerful that it makes my hair stand on end with joy.
translation.deep: In this moment, Sanjaya shares his profound awe at having witnessed the sacred dialogue between the Divine and the seeker. The words shared between Krishna and Arjuna are not merely instructions, but a spiritual energy so intense and beautiful that it creates a physical and emotional thrill of pure devotion.
translation.essence: When we truly listen to the wisdom of the Divine, our entire being responds with wonder, and our heart is filled with a sacred stillness.

18-75.transliteration:
vyāsa-prasādāch chhrutavān etad guhyam ahaṁ param
yogaṁ yogeśhvarāt kṛiṣhṇāt sākṣhāt kathayataḥ svayam

translation.simple: By the grace of Sage Vyasa, I have been blessed to hear this supreme and most secret wisdom of Yoga, spoken directly by Lord Krishna Himself, the Master of all Yoga.
translation.deep: Sanjaya reflects on the immense privilege of receiving divine vision. It is through the kindness of his teacher that he could witness the ultimate truth. He recognizes that this sacred knowledge didn't come through second-hand accounts, but flowed directly from the heart of the Divine to the seeker.
translation.essence: Spiritual awakening is a gift of grace that connects us directly to the voice of the Divine within.

18-76.sanskrit: राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम्।केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः।।18.76।।
18-76.transliteration:
rājan sansmṛitya sansmṛitya saṁvādam imam adbhutam
keśhavārjunayoḥ puṇyaṁ hṛiṣhyāmi cha muhur muhuḥ

translation.simple: O King, as I repeatedly remember this wonderful and sacred dialogue between Lord Krishna and Arjuna, I am filled with a deep sense of joy and wonder over and over again.
translation.deep: Sanjaya reveals the transformative power of spiritual remembrance. It is not a mere memory of words, but a living experience of the Divine presence. Each time we dwell upon the holy conversation of the Gita, the soul is purified and the heart is overwhelmed by a bliss that never fades, reminding us that the Lord's grace is an eternal source of happiness.
translation.essence: The constant remembrance of the Divine's teachings brings a soul-stirring joy that renews itself at every moment.

18-77.sanskrit:
तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः।

विस्मयो मे महान् राजन् हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः।।18.77।।
18-77.transliteration:
tach cha sansmṛitya saṁsmṛitya rūpam aty-adbhutaṁ hareḥ
vismayo ye mahān rājan hṛiṣhyāmi cha punaḥ punaḥ

translation.simple: O King, as I remember that most wonderful and extraordinary form of Lord Krishna again and again, I am struck with great wonder and I overflow with joy over and over.
translation.deep: Sanjaya expresses the profound impact of witnessing the Divine. The memory of the Lord's magnificent form is not a static thought but a living source of spiritual ecstasy. Each time the mind touches that divine image, it experiences a fresh wave of awe and an unending surge of inner bliss, proving that the presence of the Divine is eternally enchanting.
translation.essence: Meditation on the beauty and glory of the Divine brings a constant state of wonder and deep, recurring joy to the heart.

18-78.sanskrit:
यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः।

तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम।।18.78।
18-78.transliteration:
yatra yogeśhvaraḥ kṛiṣhṇo yatra pārtho dhanur-dharaḥ
tatra śhrīr vijayo bhūtir dhruvā nītir matir mama

translation.simple: Wherever the Divine Master Krishna and the devoted seeker Arjuna are together, there will surely be prosperity, victory, and steady goodness. This is the ultimate truth.
translation.deep: This verse marks the sacred union of Divine Wisdom and human effort. When we align our personal actions with the Divine Will, we are blessed with enduring success, moral strength, and spiritual abundance.
translation.essence: True victory and lasting peace are found only when we walk hand-in-hand with the Divine.
